capabilities: Compare two local JSON files from a dialog
Preview added, removed, and changed values with JSON Pointer paths
Create a Markdown report note with links to both source files
Save named file pairs for reuse (Pro)
extras: Freemium: comparison and reports are free; named pairs and ignore paths require Pro via GitHub Sponsors. Needs Obsidian 1.13.4+. Sources are limited to 2 MiB and 64 nesting levels; previews cap at 1,000 changes. No network requests until the user signs in with GitHub; the What's new tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat but sends no data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to diff two JSON files or produce a change report note from the comparison.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Compares two JSON files in the vault and saves a Markdown report of added, removed, and changed values.
